bundles.name: Caddy
bundles.compose:
# Caddy edge — curated Omahab bundle
# Pinned digest is REQUIRED: substituted from signed release manifest via ${CADDY_DIGEST}
# omahabd validates image matches ^[^@]+@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$ after envsubst and refuses to pull otherwise.
# No mutable tags are allowed.
name: omahab-caddy
networks:
  omahab:
    name: omahab
    external: true
services:
  caddy:
    image: {{.Image}}@{{.Digest}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["caddy", "run", "--config", "/etc/caddy/caddy.json", "--watch"]
    # Edge is the only bundle that publishes host ports. All other bundles use `expose` and are reachable via Caddy.
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:80:80"
      - "${TAILSCALE_IP:?tailscale IP required}:80:80"
      - "127.0.0.1:443:443"
      - "${TAILSCALE_IP:?tailscale IP required}:443:443"
      - "${TAILSCALE_IP:?tailscale IP required}:443:443/udp"
    volumes:
      - caddy_data:/data
      - caddy_config:/config
      - /etc/omahab/caddy.json:/etc/caddy/caddy.json:ro
      - /var/lib/omahab/caddy:/var/lib/caddy:ro
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    networks:
      omahab:
        ipv4_address: 172.30.0.2
        aliases:
          - id.${DOMAIN:?domain required}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "caddy version >/dev/null 2>&1 && wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:2019/config/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    # NO Docker socket mount. Never mount docker socket into applications.
volumes:
  caddy_data:
    name: caddy_data
  caddy_config:
    name: caddy_config

post_restore: systemctl reload caddy || docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/caddy/compose.yaml exec caddy caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile || true

bundles.name: Pocket ID
bundles.compose:
# Pocket ID — curated Omahab bundle
# Passkey-first OIDC IdP. Private by default, shared via Tunnel+Access when enabled.
name: omahab-pocket-id
networks:
  omahab:
    name: omahab
    external: true
services:
  pocket-id:
    image: {{.Image}}@{{.Digest}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "1411"
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:1411:1411"
    environment:
      # omahabd templates non-secret env; secrets via *_FILE -> /run/secrets
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      APP_URL: "https://id.${DOMAIN:?domain required}/"
      TRUST_PROXY: "true"
      STATIC_API_KEY: "${STATIC_API_KEY:?static api key required}"
      ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE: /run/secrets/pocket_id_encryption_key
      MAXMIND_LICENSE_FILE: /run/secrets/maxmind_license
    secrets:
      - pocket_id_encryption_key
      - maxmind_license
    volumes:
      - pocket_id_data:/app/backend/data
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:1411/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 20s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    # No host port publishing reachable only via Caddy reverse_proxy on private bridge.
    # No Docker socket mount.
secrets:
  pocket_id_encryption_key:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/pocket_id_encryption_key
  maxmind_license:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/maxmind_license
volumes:
  pocket_id_data:
    name: pocket_id_data

pre_backup: docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/pocket-id/compose.yaml exec pocket-id /app/backend/pocket-id backup --out /tmp/pocket-id-backup.db || cp /app/backend/data/data.db /tmp/pocket-id-backup.db
post_restore: docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/pocket-id/compose.yaml exec pocket-id /app/backend/pocket-id restore --in /tmp/pocket-id-backup.db || cp /tmp/pocket-id-backup.db /app/backend/data/data.db

bundles.name: Forgejo
bundles.compose:
# Forgejo — curated Omahab bundle
# Private by default. Native OIDC to Pocket ID. Postgres dump required for consistent backup.
name: omahab-forgejo
networks:
  omahab:
    name: omahab
    external: true
services:
  forgejo:
    image: {{.Image}}@{{.Digest}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      forgejo-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      forgejo-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    expose:
      - "3000"
      - "22"
    environment:
      USER_UID: "1000"
      USER_GID: "1000"
      FORGEJO__database__DB_TYPE: postgres
      FORGEJO__database__HOST: forgejo-postgres:5432
      FORGEJO__database__NAME: forgejo
      FORGEJO__database__USER: forgejo
      FORGEJO__database__PASSWD_FILE: /run/secrets/forgejo_db_password
      FORGEJO__security__SECRET_KEY_FILE: /run/secrets/forgejo_secret_key
      FORGEJO__security__INSTALL_LOCK: "true"
      FORGEJO__service__DISABLE_REGISTRATION: "true"
      FORGEJO__server__ROOT_URL: "https://git.${DOMAIN:?domain required}/"
      FORGEJO__server__SSH_DOMAIN: "git.${DOMAIN}"
    secrets:
      - forgejo_db_password
      - forgejo_secret_key
    volumes:
      - forgejo_data:/data
      - /etc/omahab/forgejo/app.ini:/data/custom/conf/app.ini:ro
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:3000/-/healthz || curl -f http://127.0.0.1:3000/-/healthz || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    # No ports, no docker socket

  forgejo-postgres:
    image: docker.io/library/postgres@sha256:cf78e76683b9ca8c5733cbbdce6c9262b45b6767934dd0a95e671f9a0fc20685
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "5432"
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: forgejo
      POSTGRES_USER: forgejo
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/forgejo_db_password
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    secrets:
      - forgejo_db_password
    volumes:
      - forgejo_postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U forgejo -d forgejo || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"

  forgejo-redis:
    image: docker.io/library/redis@sha256:ff02b58f971e7d7d156a1267e283fcbbeee91773b6aa36c49dac28ecfe28eadf
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "6379"
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes", "--save", "60", "1"]
    volumes:
      - forgejo_redis_data:/data
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

secrets:
  forgejo_db_password:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/forgejo_db_password
  forgejo_secret_key:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/forgejo_secret_key
volumes:
  forgejo_data:
    name: forgejo_data
  forgejo_postgres_data:
    name: forgejo_postgres_data
  forgejo_redis_data:
    name: forgejo_redis_data

pre_backup: docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/forgejo/compose.yaml exec forgejo-postgres pg_dump -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-forgejo} -Fc -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-forgejo} -f /tmp/forgejo.pgdump && docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/forgejo/compose.yaml exec forgejo forgejo dump --file /tmp/forgejo_app.zip --type zip || true
post_restore: docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/forgejo/compose.yaml exec forgejo-postgres pg_restore -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-forgejo} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-forgejo} --clean --if-exists /tmp/forgejo.pgdump && docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/forgejo/compose.yaml restart forgejo

bundles.name: Woodpecker CI
bundles.compose:
# Woodpecker CI — curated Omahab bundle
# Server + agent pair integrated with Forgejo. Forgejo Actions disabled.
name: omahab-woodpecker
networks:
  omahab:
    name: omahab
    external: true
services:
  woodpecker-server:
    image: {{.Image}}@{{.Digest}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      woodpecker-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    expose:
      - "8000"
    environment:
      WOODPECKER_OPEN: "false"
      WOODPECKER_HOST: "https://ci.${DOMAIN:?domain required}"
      WOODPECKER_FORGEJO: "true"
      WOODPECKER_FORGEJO_URL: "https://git.${DOMAIN}/"
      WOODPECKER_FORGEJO_CLIENT: "${WOODPECKER_FORGEJO_CLIENT:?forgejo oauth client id required}"
      WOODPECKER_FORGEJO_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE: /run/secrets/woodpecker_forgejo_client_secret
      WOODPECKER_AGENT_SECRET_FILE: /run/secrets/woodpecker_agent_secret
      WOODPECKER_DATABASE_DRIVER: postgres
      WOODPECKER_DATABASE_DATASOURCE: "postgres://woodpecker:${WOODPECKER_DB_PASSWORD:?}@woodpecker-postgres:5432/woodpecker?sslmode=disable"
      # Prefer file-based secret; omahabd will template datasource from file if supported, otherwise inject via envsubst at deploy time.
    secrets:
      - woodpecker_forgejo_client_secret
      - woodpecker_agent_secret
      - woodpecker_db_password
    volumes:
      - woodpecker_data:/var/lib/woodpecker
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz || curl -f http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz || exit 1"]
      interval: 20s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 20s
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"

  woodpecker-agent:
    image: docker.io/woodpeckerci/woodpecker-agent@sha256:d95ac8a778881709c05d2ec931577e278447cc4097fd31122955c169d264b7e4
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      woodpecker-server:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      WOODPECKER_SERVER: "woodpecker-server:9000"
      WOODPECKER_AGENT_SECRET_FILE: /run/secrets/woodpecker_agent_secret
      WOODPECKER_MAX_WORKFLOWS: "2"
      WOODPECKER_FILTER_LABELS: "type=docker"
      # Woodpecker agent builds OCI images. Docker access is brokered via omahabd's
      # controlled deployment layer on 127.0.0.1 — no direct docker socket mount
      # into any application or agent container. omahabd validates that no compose
      # file mounts docker socket; builds use a restricted BuildKit endpoint instead.
      WOODPECKER_BACKEND: docker
      DOCKER_HOST: tcp://omahabd-builder:2375
    secrets:
      - woodpecker_agent_secret
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "ps aux | grep -q woodpecker-agent || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3

  woodpecker-postgres:
    image: docker.io/library/postgres@sha256:cf78e76683b9ca8c5733cbbdce6c9262b45b6767934dd0a95e671f9a0fc20685
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "5432"
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: woodpecker
      POSTGRES_USER: woodpecker
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/woodpecker_db_password
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    secrets:
      - woodpecker_db_password
    volumes:
      - woodpecker_postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U woodpecker -d woodpecker || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s

secrets:
  woodpecker_forgejo_client_secret:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/woodpecker_forgejo_client_secret
  woodpecker_agent_secret:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/woodpecker_agent_secret
  woodpecker_db_password:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/woodpecker_db_password
volumes:
  woodpecker_data:
    name: woodpecker_data
  woodpecker_postgres_data:
    name: woodpecker_postgres_data

post_restore: docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/woodpecker/compose.yaml exec woodpecker-postgres pg_restore -U ${WOODPECKER_POSTGRES_USER:-woodpecker} -d ${WOODPECKER_POSTGRES_DB:-woodpecker} --clean --if-exists /tmp/woodpecker.pgdump && docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/woodpecker/compose.yaml restart woodpecker-server woodpecker-agent

bundles.name: Immich
bundles.compose:
# Immich — curated Omahab bundle
# Includes server + ML (isolated but co-deployed), Postgres/VectorChord, Valkey.
# Library on host bind /srv/omahab/apps/immich/library for restic backup efficiency.
name: omahab-immich
networks:
  omahab:
    name: omahab
    external: true
services:
  immich-server:
    image: {{.Image}}@{{.Digest}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      immich-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      immich-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    expose:
      - "2283"
    environment:
      DB_HOSTNAME: immich-postgres
      DB_USERNAME: postgres
      DB_DATABASE_NAME: immich
      DB_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/immich_db_password
      REDIS_HOSTNAME: immich-redis
      IMMICH_MACHINE_LEARNING_URL: "http://immich-machine-learning:3003"
      IMMICH_PUBLIC_URL: "https://photos.${DOMAIN:?domain required}/"
      IMMICH_CONFIG_FILE: /config/immich.json
    secrets:
      - immich_db_password
    volumes:
      - /srv/omahab/apps/immich/library:/data
      - /srv/omahab/apps/immich/immich.json:/config/immich.json:ro
    networks:
      omahab:
        aliases:
          - immich
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://127.0.0.1:2283/api/server/ping || wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:2283/api/server/ping || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 60s
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"

  immich-machine-learning:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning@sha256:5a0839dc5303cd7215bcd2180a26aed3af41675aefb3e75e5157e9f10ad16e6e
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "3003"
    volumes:
      - immich_model_cache:/cache
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:3003/ping')"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 120s
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2G

  immich-postgres:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres@sha256:bcf63357191b76a916ae5eb93464d65c07511da41e3bf7a8416db519b40b1c23
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "5432"
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: immich
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/immich_db_password
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    secrets:
      - immich_db_password
    volumes:
      - immich_postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d immich || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 20s

  immich-redis:
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey@sha256:a91d34ab33975b1054e26f1bd9995b268f7e0c507b5ded7f3d181a1a25521630
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "6379"
    volumes:
      - immich_redis_data:/data
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

secrets:
  immich_db_password:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/immich_db_password
volumes:
  immich_postgres_data:
    name: immich_postgres_data
  immich_redis_data:
    name: immich_redis_data
  immich_model_cache:
    name: immich_model_cache

pre_backup: docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/immich/compose.yaml exec immich-postgres pg_dump -U ${IMMICH_POSTGRES_USER:-postgres} -Fc -d ${IMMICH_POSTGRES_DB:-immich} -f /tmp/immich.pgdump && docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/immich/compose.yaml exec immich-server immich backup --out /tmp/immich_library_manifest.json || echo 'library manifest hook placeholder'
post_restore: docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/immich/compose.yaml exec immich-postgres pg_restore -U ${IMMICH_POSTGRES_USER:-postgres} -d ${IMMICH_POSTGRES_DB:-immich} --clean --if-exists /tmp/immich.pgdump && rsync -a /backups/immich/library/ /srv/omahab/apps/immich/library/ || cp -a /tmp/immich_library/* /srv/omahab/apps/immich/library/ && docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/immich/compose.yaml restart immich-server

bundles.name: Paperless-ngx
bundles.compose:
# Paperless-ngx — curated Omahab bundle
# Postgres + redis + gotenberg + tika sidecars. Native OIDC to Pocket ID.
name: omahab-paperless
networks:
  omahab:
    name: omahab
    external: true
services:
  paperless:
    image: {{.Image}}@{{.Digest}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      paperless-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      paperless-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      gotenberg:
        condition: service_started
      tika:
        condition: service_started
    expose:
      - "8000"
    environment:
      PAPERLESS_URL: "https://docs.${DOMAIN:?domain required}/"
      PAPERLESS_REDIS: "redis://paperless-redis:6379/0"
      PAPERLESS_DBHOST: paperless-postgres
      PAPERLESS_DBNAME: paperless
      PAPERLESS_DBUSER: paperless
      PAPERLESS_DBPASS_FILE: /run/secrets/paperless_db_password
      PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY_FILE: /run/secrets/paperless_secret_key
      PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE: eng
      PAPERLESS_TIKA_ENABLED: "1"
      PAPERLESS_TIKA_GOTENBERG_ENDPOINT: "http://gotenberg:3000"
      PAPERLESS_TIKA_ENDPOINT: "http://tika:9998"
      PAPERLESS_ENABLE_HTTP_REMOTE_USER: "false"
      PAPERLESS_APPS: allauth.socialaccount.providers.openid_connect
      PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_OIDC_ISSUER: "https://id.${DOMAIN}/"
    secrets:
      - paperless_db_password
      - paperless_secret_key
    volumes:
      - /srv/omahab/apps/paperless/data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - /srv/omahab/apps/paperless/media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - /srv/omahab/apps/paperless/consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
      - /srv/omahab/apps/paperless/export:/usr/src/paperless/export
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/ || wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"

  paperless-postgres:
    image: docker.io/library/postgres@sha256:cf78e76683b9ca8c5733cbbdce6c9262b45b6767934dd0a95e671f9a0fc20685
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "5432"
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: paperless
      POSTGRES_USER: paperless
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/paperless_db_password
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    secrets:
      - paperless_db_password
    volumes:
      - paperless_postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U paperless -d paperless || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s

  paperless-redis:
    image: docker.io/library/redis@sha256:ff02b58f971e7d7d156a1267e283fcbbeee91773b6aa36c49dac28ecfe28eadf
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "6379"
    volumes:
      - paperless_redis_data:/data
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

  gotenberg:
    image: docker.io/gotenberg/gotenberg@sha256:87c16b9f364279d321bc9772d31fa58aa6abe036423c270698bd636c3a8e9466
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "3000"
    command: ["gotenberg", "--api-timeout=30s", "--chromium-disable-javascript=false"]
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://127.0.0.1:3000/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3

  tika:
    image: docker.io/apache/tika@sha256:a8b442501f601fb15015de974f9afe13dd242b0f14e49a2b144fadcb214a555b
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "9998"
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://127.0.0.1:9998/tika || curl -f http://127.0.0.1:9998/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3

secrets:
  paperless_db_password:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/paperless_db_password
  paperless_secret_key:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/paperless_secret_key
volumes:
  paperless_postgres_data:
    name: paperless_postgres_data
  paperless_redis_data:
    name: paperless_redis_data

pre_backup: docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/paperless-ngx/compose.yaml exec paperless-postgres pg_dump -U ${PAPERLESS_POSTGRES_USER:-paperless} -Fc -d ${PAPERLESS_POSTGRES_DB:-paperless} -f /tmp/paperless.pgdump && docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/paperless-ngx/compose.yaml exec paperless document_exporter --no-progress --zip /tmp/paperless_export.zip || docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/paperless-ngx/compose.yaml exec paperless python3 manage.py document_exporter /tmp/paperless_export --zip --no-progress || true
post_restore: docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/paperless-ngx/compose.yaml exec paperless-postgres pg_restore -U ${PAPERLESS_POSTGRES_USER:-paperless} -d ${PAPERLESS_POSTGRES_DB:-paperless} --clean --if-exists /tmp/paperless.pgdump && docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/paperless-ngx/compose.yaml exec paperless python3 manage.py document_importer /tmp/paperless_export --no-progress || rsync -a /backups/paperless/media/ /srv/omahab/apps/paperless/media/ && docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/paperless-ngx/compose.yaml restart paperless

bundles.name: Syncthing
bundles.compose:
# Syncthing — curated Omahab bundle
# GUI on private bridge only. No sync protocol exposure via Caddy; LAN discovery/Tailscale handles peer transport.
name: omahab-syncthing
networks:
  omahab:
    name: omahab
    external: true
services:
  syncthing:
    image: {{.Image}}@{{.Digest}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    hostname: syncthing
    expose:
      - "8384"
      - "22000"
      - "21027/udp"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      STGUIADDRESS: "0.0.0.0:8384"
      STGUIAPIKEY_FILE: /run/secrets/syncthing_api_key
    secrets:
      - syncthing_api_key
      - syncthing_gui_password
    volumes:
      - syncthing_config:/var/syncthing/config
      - /srv/omahab/sync:/var/syncthing:rw
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:8384/rest/system/ping || curl -fk https://127.0.0.1:8384/rest/system/ping || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 20s
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    # No host port publishing; GUI via Caddy private route sync.<domain> -> syncthing:8384
    # Sync protocol (22000/tcp, 21027/udp) is host-local discovery; peers connect via Tailscale/LAN.
    # Do not publish 22000/21027 via Caddy.
    # No Docker socket mount.

secrets:
  syncthing_api_key:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/syncthing_api_key
  syncthing_gui_password:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/syncthing_gui_password
volumes:
  syncthing_config:
    name: syncthing_config

command: curl -fk https://127.0.0.1:8384/rest/system/ping -H "X-API-Key: $(cat /run/secrets/syncthing_api_key 2>/dev/null || echo dummy)" || wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:8384/rest/system/ping || exit 1

pre_backup: docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/syncthing/compose.yaml exec syncthing syncthing cli --gui-apikey $(cat /run/secrets/syncthing_api_key) operations pause || true && sleep 2

bundles.name: LiteLLM Model Gateway
bundles.compose:
# LiteLLM gateway — curated Omahab bundle
# OpenAI-compatible proxy + credential broker. Private-only, no Tunnel public exposure.
name: omahab-litellm
networks:
  omahab:
    name: omahab
    external: true
services:
  litellm:
    image: {{.Image}}@{{.Digest}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      litellm-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    expose:
      - "4000"
    environment:
      LITELLM_MASTER_KEY_FILE: /run/secrets/litellm_master_key
      DATABASE_URL_FILE: /run/secrets/litellm_db_url
      LITELLM_SALT_KEY_FILE: /run/secrets/litellm_salt_key
      STORE_MODEL_IN_DB: "true"
      LITELLM_CONFIG_PATH: /app/config/litellm.yaml
    secrets:
      - litellm_master_key
      - litellm_db_url
      - litellm_salt_key
    volumes:
      - litellm_config:/app/config:ro
    command: ["--config", "/app/config/litellm.yaml", "--detailed_debug"]
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://127.0.0.1:4000/health/liveliness || wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:4000/health/liveliness || exit 1"]
      interval: 20s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 20s
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"

  litellm-postgres:
    image: docker.io/library/postgres@sha256:cf78e76683b9ca8c5733cbbdce6c9262b45b6767934dd0a95e671f9a0fc20685
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "5432"
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: litellm
      POSTGRES_USER: litellm
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/litellm_db_password
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    secrets:
      - litellm_db_password
    volumes:
      - litellm_postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U litellm -d litellm || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s

secrets:
  litellm_master_key:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/litellm_master_key
  litellm_db_url:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/litellm_db_url
  litellm_salt_key:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/litellm_salt_key
  litellm_db_password:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/litellm_db_password
volumes:
  litellm_config:
    name: litellm_config
  litellm_postgres_data:
    name: litellm_postgres_data

post_restore: docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/litellm/compose.yaml exec litellm-postgres pg_restore -U ${LITELLM_POSTGRES_USER:-litellm} -d ${LITELLM_POSTGRES_DB:-litellm} --clean --if-exists /tmp/litellm.pgdump && docker compose -f /srv/omahab/apps/litellm/compose.yaml restart litellm

bundles.name: ntfy
bundles.compose:
# ntfy — curated Omahab OPTIONAL bundle
# Disabled by default. Optional push adapter for normalized events.
# When enabled, omahabd fan-outs events → ntfy topics.
name: omahab-ntfy
networks:
  omahab:
    name: omahab
    external: true
services:
  ntfy:
    image: {{.Image}}@{{.Digest}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "80"
    environment:
      NTFY_AUTH_FILE: /run/secrets/ntfy_auth_file
      NTFY_BEHIND_PROXY: "true"
      NTFY_BASE_URL: "https://ntfy.${DOMAIN:?domain required}"
    secrets:
      - ntfy_auth_file
    volumes:
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_config:/etc/ntfy
      - /etc/omahab/ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
    command: ["serve"]
    networks:
      - omahab
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:80/v1/health || curl -f http://127.0.0.1:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
    # No host ports; Caddy routes ntfy.<domain> -> ntfy:80 when enabled.
    # No Docker socket mount.

secrets:
  ntfy_auth_file:
    file: /var/lib/omahab/secrets/ntfy_auth_file
volumes:
  ntfy_cache:
    name: ntfy_cache
  ntfy_config:
    name: ntfy_config
